scientific_boundaries.residual_claim: Residual is NOT automatically tyre degradation; it is an unexplained difference between actual and expected vehicle dynamics.
scientific_boundaries.confounder_claim: non_tyre_explanation_score is NOT a probability or causal model; it is a deterministic physical plausibility metric.
scientific_boundaries.evidence_claim: tyre_evidence_quality is NOT tyre health or physical wear; it is an analytical weighting of sample suitability.
scientific_boundaries.tyre_age_claim: TyreLife represents lap age count, NOT physical tread depth in millimeters.
scientific_boundaries.causality_claim: No causal wear claim is made in this phase without downstream persistence and TDI analysis.
